caveats: Arrival rate was configured at 400 tasks/s for every workload, which is 1.25x capacity for uniform and multi_tenant and about 1.28x for heavy_tailed.

The bursty workload ignores the configured rate (its arrivals come from the burst schedule), so the bursty cells of this run were measured at about 1.57x capacity, not 1.25x. This is the confound described in report section 3.2. Compare bursty against the other workloads only in the load sweep, which derives each workload's rate from measured capacity.
command: make merge OUT=final-25rep RUNS="uniform-25rep stable-25rep heavy-25rep"
title: Main matrix: four policies by four workloads, 25 repetitions
